specify.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a finished landscape 16:10 brand-led editorial cover for Specify, a developer documentation app. Reference image 1 is the real Specify logo: preserve its distinctive curved S silhouette and violet-purple coloring; it is a brand reference, not a screenshot to reproduce. The user's priorities are that the image immediately feels like Specify, uses its signature purple, fits a premium near-black portfolio, and looks natural rather than a glossy AI render.
Photograph a beautifully simple tangible workspace still life: a large violet-purple linen-bound notebook with the real S logo neatly blind-embossed and subtly foil-printed on its cover, resting slightly diagonally beside a real graphite laptop whose screen shows a softly defocused dark document editor and code pane. A single ivory open page with restrained handwritten annotations and a nice black pencil naturally overlap the notebook. Close tabletop composition, notebook logo is the dominant visual, code-to-document connection suggested through real objects, no invented readable wording. Deep plum/charcoal desk, real matte materials, slight paper imperfections, soft natural window light, restrained warm highlights, realistic shadows, gentle film grain. Signature palette violet #7c3aed, purple #8b5cf6, deep plum, warm ivory; violet unmistakable but not glowing. Strong central graphic composition legible at 320px thumbnail, entire scene about 70% frame, generous calm edges. Real independent design-magazine photography, tasteful and inviting. NO floating icons, NO neon ribbons, NO particles, NO glass slab effects, NO fake holograms, NO 3D-render look, NO landing page screenshot, NO readable headlines, NO stock-photo people, NO watermark. Image fills frame, not a mock web page.

mamma.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a finished landscape 16:10 charming brand cover for the Mamma parenting app. Reference image 1 is Mamma's official baby-bottle icon and its signature palette; use it as a strong character-design and color reference. The user explicitly wants a cute bottle and cute gentle colors, immediately recognizable as Mamma, natural and thoughtfully crafted instead of generic shiny AI art.
Art direction: beautiful professionally hand-crafted editorial illustration, soft hand-cut paper collage with gentle gouache texture, subtle tactile grain and rounded organic shapes; NOT photoreal baby, NOT glossy CGI or 3D product render. Main subject: a large adorable friendly baby bottle inspired closely by the supplied icon: warm ivory bottle, coral-rose pink cap (#f43f5e/#ff5368), small golden-orange teat, tiny dark-navy markings, soft pastel pink milk, a small sweet understated smiling face. Tilt the bottle slightly as if giving a friendly hello, surrounded by a very few soft paper-cut companions: a sleepy cream crescent moon, a tiny coral heart, and three rounded pastel blocks forming a gentle growth step. No floating neon or magic effects. Palette: blush pink #fff1f2, peach, coral #f43f5e, creamy ivory, a little soft golden yellow, dark navy only for tiny details. Warm blush-paper background with sophisticated understated tonal shapes, natural soft shadows as though real layered craft paper was photographed in diffuse daylight. Focal bottle occupies about 55% of frame; all elements form a clear balanced central scene with generous breathing room and readable silhouette at 320px. Cute, comforting, playful but beautifully restrained, looks like an intentional illustration for a real parenting brand. NO text, NO wordmark, NO smartphone, NO browser, NO landing page, NO plastic surfaces, NO shiny glass, NO sci-fi, NO overdone sparkles, NO excessive decorative clutter, NO watermark. Full bleed rectangular image.

petty.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium cinematic project cover for Petty, an AI character conversation and roleplay storytelling app, in a sophisticated black minimalist portfolio.
Generate one landscape image approximately 1600x1000, 16:10 composition. Art direction: premium cinematic anime illustration with sculptural 3D depth, black-indigo background, controlled violet and rose accents, luminous fine particles, elegant dramatic lighting, subtle grain. A beautiful softly glowing open storybook floats centrally near the bottom; from its pages rises a curved luminous violet portal like an unfolding story. Two distinct appealing adult fictional characters emerge in elegant half-body portraits inside the portal, a silver-haired fantasy male traveler and a dark-haired contemporary female protagonist, adults in their twenties wearing tasteful layered dark clothing, sharing a subtle engaged gaze. A tiny white cat familiar sits at the base of the book with its back to camera and a small purple scarf, grounding the Petty mood. Show connection and narrative possibility, not romance clichés. Clear silhouettes, expressive attractive mature faces; characters and portal form a coherent central sculptural scene, legible at a 320px thumbnail. 70% subject coverage, generous deep dark space, ethereal but restrained, premium game key-art quality without visual clutter. NO text or letters, NO slogans, NO logos, NO chat UI, NO phones, NO browser, NO landing screenshot, NO watermark, NO childish characters. Full-bleed opaque image, near-black edges to integrate into the portfolio.
petty.selection: User selected original fantasy illustration; preserved composition without cropping.
